_comment: ADR-003 §5 rule 1 (A 2026-11-03): the modules tools/fabric/state_writes.py admits although they resolve the per-agent state directory and write a file, or read AGENT_FABRIC_STATE_DIR themselves. Each value says why: the record's clause that admits it, or 'not state:' and what it writes instead. An entry admits the whole module, a later write in it included. Lock files on their terms (os.open, O_CREAT, no O_TRUNC, 0o600) are never findings and need no entry.

writers.tools/fabric/control/upgrade.py: ADR-003 §2, rule 1: the control code; restart.json by temporary and rename, its path resolved for an explicit home
writers.tools/fabric/control/ops/usage.py: ADR-003 §2, rule 1: the control code; writes under <state root>/accounts/, not agents/<login>/
writers.tools/fabric/episodic.py: ADR-003 §2, rule 1: episodic.db, the self-contained transactional store (A 2026-10-05)
writers.tools/fabric/gzcoord/bypass.py: ADR-003 rule 1: journal-bypass.jsonl, a GZCoord log (A 2026-10-05)
writers.tools/fabric/gzcoord/send.py: not state: the caller's message file, rewritten with its minted MESSAGE-ID by temporary and rename; gzcoord-sent.jsonl, the send ledger, is appended and trimmed under identity.agent_lock with identity.atomic_write
not state: appends to the harness's CLAUDE_ENV_FILE
writers.tools/fabric/assembler/report.py: not state: a project's last-drain-report.json and a caller-named commit message file
writers.tools/fabric/review_codex.py: not state: the review's scratch under the account's temporary directory
writers.tools/fabric/review_rounds.py: not state: a review request beside the caller's own request file; the saved rounds go through identity.atomic_write
writers.tools/fabric/role.py: not state: moves a role activation's workspace files, never agents/<login>/
writers.tools/fabric/control/gateway_switch.py: ADR-003 §2, rule 1: the control code; the switch and gateway records §2 names, by temporary and rename
writers.tools/fabric/fabric_writes.py: not state: keeps a person's file under .before-agent-fabric beside it; its record goes through identity.atomic_write
writers.tools/fabric/secretstore/statecopy.py: not state: reads the state directory (episodic.db by SQLite's online backup) and writes into the login's own store
writers.tools/fabric/launcher/session.py: not state: marks the harness's onboarding done in <CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or home>/.claude.json; a state_dir it takes goes to launch_provider_record
writers.tools/fabric/memory_flagrun.py: not state: the request goes through a private temporary directory, and its report is a project's last-drain-report.json
writers.tools/fabric/launcher/gateway.py: not state: marks the gateway-local key approved in the harness's .claude.json by temporary and rename; the gateway's log descriptor comes from identity.open_log_fd and the gateway record goes through identity.atomic_write
writers.tools/fabric/secretstore/relaycopy.py: not state: the backup's scratch, its manifest and a restored copy; relay-backup.jsonl goes through identity.append_line
